scope: Read-only analysis of the installed public Steam binary and Lua sources through local Ghidra. No live game login or game-server request was performed for this note. It does not establish current Steam server interoperability, a completed vehicle collection, or the cause of earlier collection timeouts.

request20.wire: u8 count; count * (u32 player correlation ID, u8 requested-field mask).
request20.maskSelection: 0x005b1370 -> 0x005af350 visits each selected field strategy independently. 0x005b0700 sends only bits whose field loader reports that a new request is needed, rather than blindly reusing the caller mask.
request20.cachePolicy: Capsule and tactics loaders 0x005af400 and 0x005af910 keep separate per-ID timestamps and pending requirement vectors. The capsule-list UI supplies a 30-second cache-age parameter; a fresh field with no pending requirements needs no new request.

reply19.handler: 0x005ac8f0 -> vector reader 0x005aa1e0 -> descriptor reader 0x005ad840; application loop 0x005ae160 dispatches each descriptor through 0x005b0c00.
reply19.wire: u8 descriptor count; each descriptor starts u32 ID and u8 field mask. The native reader supports field bits 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16; each present bit has its own payload.
reply19.capsulePayload: Bit 4: u8 count; each capsule has u32 type, u8 generation and a u8-counted faculty vector of u8 category, u16 trend, i32 level.
reply19.tacticsPayload: Bit 8: u8 count; each record is two u32 values. Formation or slot meaning is not established here.
reply19.zeroMask: A zero-mask descriptor has no field payload and dispatches no field completion.
reply19.packetBoundary: Descriptors are processed in received order. No packet-level uniqueness check or whole-request completion marker is present in these native vector/dispatch functions.

perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.strategyRegistration: 0x005acfa0 registers capsule field index 2 (mask 4) and tactics field index 3 (mask 8). Their vtables at 0x00749e08 and 0x00749e18 share receive method 0x005b14f0 and pending lookup 0x005b03a0.
perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.receive: For an existing per-ID field record, 0x005b14f0 refreshes its timestamp, copies that one field through its registered copier, and completes and clears that field pending requirement vector via 0x005b0f60(success=1).
perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.capsuleCopy: 0x005b1250 -> 0x005ad500 replaces the capsule vector. An empty supplied capsule vector clears the cached vector and still completes the field.
perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.tacticsCopy: 0x005b12d0 -> 0x0057a3c0 separately replaces the tactics vector and completes that field, including an empty vector.
perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.partialSuccess: A mask-4 update completes capsules without completing pending mask 8, and vice versa. Split fields may arrive in separate descriptors or packets.
perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.repeatedField: A later descriptor for the same existing ID and field repeats the cache replacement and then completes an already empty pending vector. The native method does not reject it as a duplicate.
perFieldCompletionAndReplacement.lateField: The receive method tests whether the per-ID field record exists; it does not require a nonempty pending vector. Thus a later valid field can refresh an existing cache after its earlier transaction has completed.

failure18AndWarmupReplay.failureDispatch: 0x005ac860 reads the ID vector and calls 0x005ae360. That loop invokes nickname request 16 through 0x005adeb0 for every ID; it does not reject an ID because a different detail field already completed.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.request16Throttle: Send condition is last_request_seconds + 10 < current_seconds, independently per ID.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.assemblyReturnDetail: In 0x005adeb0, JGE at 0x005adf5f skips sending through the common epilogue, and MOV AL,1 at 0x005ae02b executes on both the send and throttle-skip paths. Ordinary throttling therefore does not take the caller false-return failure branch.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.reply17Success: Handler 0x005ac7e0 dispatches to 0x005ae040. Only status 0 stores the returned nickname and invokes 0x005afd00(ID,1); this path does not run for a nonzero status.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.remainingMask: 0x005afd00 asks 0x005afc60 to OR bits only for field strategies whose per-ID pending requirement vector remains nonempty, then emits a one-ID request 20 carrying that remaining mask through 0x005acc70.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.partialExample: If capsules (4) completed before the miss and tactics (8) remain pending, successful warm-up reissues mask 8. If tactics completed and capsules remain pending, it reissues mask 4. Already completed fields are not automatically included.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.otherReplayTrigger: Reply-380 mask-4 nickname completion also calls 0x005afd00. A successful nickname-field update can therefore reissue still-pending detail fields without waiting for a separate reply 17.
failure18AndWarmupReplay.noTimeoutReplayProof: This inspected path provides no automatic timeout retry or promise of a new reply after a throttled request-16 invocation.

capsuleOnlyMask4Assessment.nativeCapability: Capsule-only mask 4 is supported by the native field-selection and serialization path. It is not merely an arbitrary unrecognized mask accepted by a raw serializer.
capsuleOnlyMask4Assessment.realUiDerivedPath: The real capsule-list caller 0x00432670 requests mask 12, but per-field cache filtering in 0x005af350/0x005b0700 can emit mask 4 when only capsules need a new read. Pending-field replay after nickname completion can likewise emit mask 4 alone.
capsuleOnlyMask4Assessment.fixedCallerInventory: Direct callers inspected for 0x005b0700 include 0x0042caf0, 0x00433600 and 0x00435af0 using mask 2, 0x00432670 using mask 12, 0x00432800 selecting from 2/12/1, and the general custom-event API 0x0046ad80. No separate direct fixed-literal mask-4 caller was found in this inventory.
capsuleOnlyMask4Assessment.generalApi: 0x0046ad80 maps field selector 2 to detail mask 4 through table 0x007e9764. Assembly shows its detail-call branch is gated by BL as well; including selector 0 plus 2 reaches a detail-mask-4 call. No shipped Lua call to this general API was found during the targeted source search.
capsuleOnlyMask4Assessment.projectionDependency: The UI GetLoadedPlayerCardList binding 0x0053ba1d -> 0x00504880 reads only the capsule vector via 0x005b00a0. It does not read the tactics vector. Generation and faculty values are also carried by the capsule data.
capsuleOnlyMask4Assessment.possibleCollectorBenefit: A validated capsule-only read could remove tactics-bit-8 completion from the dependency for exporting these capsule fields. This is a testable consequence of requesting fewer fields, not evidence that tactics caused an earlier Steam timeout.

nativeUiRequestAndTiming.call: Installed ScrambleChallenge.lua line 846 calls LoadPlayerCapsuleList for the selected single player. 0x00432670 requests masks 4 and 8 and attaches their separate new requirement objects to a PlayerCapsuleListCall task.
nativeUiRequestAndTiming.uiDelayFormulaSeconds: new_requirement_count * 10 / 50.0 + 5.0, or 0 if no new requirements exist.
nativeUiRequestAndTiming.examples: 50 cold IDs with two new field requirements each give a 25-second task delay; 200 such IDs give 85 seconds. These are native UI task calculations, not measured server latencies or service guarantees.
nativeUiRequestAndTiming.completionCallback: PlayerCapsuleListCall vtable 0x00731280 invokes 0x00432380, emitting EvLoadPlayerCapsuleMsg 0x428. The generic transaction timer can release the UI even when fields remain pending; the UI event alone is not proof of a complete batch.
nativeUiRequestAndTiming.display: Installed ui/ScrambleChallengeUI.lua line 1548 enumerates GetLoadedPlayerCardList and displays generation, faculty category 1 level and category 20 Fate from that capsule data.

collectorComparisonAtReview.comparison: The reviewed collector requests mask 12 and waits until both bits complete for every batch ID. It rejects an 18 failure following any earlier field success, and rejects a repeated field or any field following a recorded failure. These checks are stricter than the native field-cache behavior described above.
collectorComparisonAtReview.requeryDifference: The reviewed collector warm-up requery sends mask 12 rather than reconstructing only fields still pending.
collectorComparisonAtReview.causalLimit: No raw live trace or fresh game request was analyzed here. The native differences identify cases to test; they do not establish the failure mode of the earlier Steam collection.

decompilationHashEncoding: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 pseudocode strings from cached Ghidra JSON responses, preserving returned line endings; no decompilation text is published.
